s_login.text:
Chosen: Stage, with the portal connecting screen from Lineup.

Signing in to an account stays in the OpenAC launcher. In the client, "login" is the connecting screen and then choosing a character.

The server only sends names. Level, look and last place are remembered by OpenAC on this computer (OPENAC, agreed). Quill was never played here, so it shows a name only. Delete keeps retail's typed DELETE.

s_create.text:
Chosen: Studio.

Gender sits with heritage. A name the server refuses offers near names (OPENAC, agreed).

Only War Mage's numbers are real (50/40/10/30/100/100). Other templates' numbers and skill costs are made up: the client reads them from the game data.

s_alt.text: The login and creation directions not chosen (2026-11-19), kept for reference.

t_small.text: Small pieces the coverage check found

s_small.text:
Every retail panel and pre-game screen was checked against the design (README, "Coverage"). These are the pieces that had no modern design yet.

Also: Options › Graphics gains "Show frame rate".

t_radar.text: Radar: five ways, and the recall menu

s_radar.text:
CHOSEN (2026-11-19): B, the bearing ring.

The radar had only ever been drawn one way. A is what the Horizon boards show; B to E are alternatives. All five show the same moment (facing north-east, nine things nearby) so they compare directly.

B to D keep retail's rules: you face the top, 75 m outdoors and 25 m indoors, retail's blip shapes and colours, the selected one ringed. A used plain dots and colours of its own.

Pick one, or mix (for example B's ring on C's lens). E can also sit beside a round radar.

t_quick.text: Quick move: hold a key, drag, done

s_quick.text:
Like HUD overlays in other clients: while the key is held (Ctrl by default, changeable), every piece of the HUD and every window can be dragged, with no unlocking. It snaps to screen edges and other pieces. Ctrl + right-click gives the quick edits for that piece. Edit layout stays for slot keys, new bars and layouts.

Open point: on a Mac, Ctrl + click often means right-click (trackpads, one-button mice). Ctrl may need to be a different default there; decided at implementation.

t_hooks.text: Plugin hooks: plugins answer, the client shows

s_hooks.text:
The client asks plugins about what is on screen and draws their answers in its own style. It never acts on them itself: anything that does something (loot the kept items) is the plugin's own button or menu entry.

Hook points: a card on Inspect and in the inventory's item details; a mark beside items in loot, inventory, trade and the vendor's sell list; entries in item menus; a page in Options › Plugins; buttons in a window's foot; buttons on the panel strip and dock.

Looter and Value Check are made-up plugins for the example.

sizesTitle.text: Sizes: play windows slim, stop windows big

sizesDock.text: Plugin dock on Modern: no lock button. Its grip and length handle show only while you hold Command (quick move) or in Edit layout, like every other HUD piece; Lock and Hide sit in its piece menu. Behaviour only, nothing to draw.
